name: handler-tracksamples-root
description: Root workspace orchestrator for Handler TrackSamples

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd backend && pnpm install && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,REACT,ELECTRON" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "pnpm run start:backend" "pnpm run start:react" "pnpm run start:electron"
scripts.start:full: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,REACT,ELECTRON" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "pnpm run start:backend" "pnpm run start:react" "pnpm run start:electron"
scripts.start:no-db: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,REACT,ELECTRON" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "pnpm run start:backend" "pnpm run start:react" "pnpm run start:electron"
